horses.spotlight_comment: This could be tactical with such a small field. Golden View (second choice) pulled well clear with the runner-up when winning at Kempton on his debut and looks a nice prospect, but YAZIN looks the one to beat on his return. The form of the selection's Newmarket success has worked out well and he should have no issue with the step up in trip. Intense Vision was 2-2 in France and is one to watch in the betting on his stable debut. [Harry March] Page 1 spotlightsouthwell 23.04.26

The drop back to 5f should suit BLUE DEVERON on his handicap debut and he's preferred ahead of Life After Love who bids to make it 3-3 over C&D. Believeinmenow is also considered on his second run since being gelded. [Harry March] Page 2 spotlightsouthwell 23.04.26

Dual C&D winner Swinging London was possibly an unfortunate loser when fourth at Pontefract last time and can again go well. However, a chance is taken on THE TRUANT who may take a step forward from his return effort. Captain Brett is also considered on his first start since disappointing at Newmarket in August. [Harry March] Page 3 spotlightsouthwell 23.04.26

may not have handled Newmarket on his final start last year but he was in good form on the AW prior to that and has since been gelded. Marnier needs to step forward from Kempton and New York Minute may not be suited by this drop back in trip. [Harry March] Page 4 spotlightsouthwell 23.04.26

Lady Ridgewood has been off since winning a maiden at Chelmsford in August but is an interesting contender, while Desert Shadow (second choice) may be able to bounce back from a lesser effort in Dubai.

This looks a good opportunity for RASPOUTINE, who is 6lb well-in under a penalty, to follow up his comfortable handicap debut success at Lingfield, with Aneirin's Sword next on the list now he's back on the AW. Lexington Express has been in fine form and is also considered. [Harry March] Page 5 spotlightsouthwell 23.04.26

Ay Up Duck has finished runner-up here on his previous two starts but RED SPELLS DANGER is selected to get off the mark at the sixth attempt. He shaped with promise in each of his four starts last year and ran a fine race on his comeback. Got The Booty went close here last time and is open to further improvement now stepping up in trip, while newcomers Turton and Katie's Song warrant a market check.[Harry March] Page 6 spotlightsouthwell 23.04.26

Enpassant (second choice) beat On Key when winning over C&D eight days ago and they are respected, while Bomb Squad is another with solid claims. However, MWAFAQ completed a hat-trick when winning on his return at Thirsk last time and is taken continue the winning thread off this 2lb higher mark. [Harry March] Page 7 spotlightsouthwell 23.04.26

Megaphone (second choice) took a step back in the right direction at Wolverhampton last time but MOOSTAR has been in good form since the tongue-tie was applied. She's selected to double her tally, with Fircombe Hall and Valsharah also considered. [Harry March] Page 8
